findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor)`. Case 0: the signer received 22089305037567995342 bbqUSDT0, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: bbqUSDT0'.

findings.evidence: Case 0: approval effect, signer 'grant', USDT allowance to the vault updated on transferFrom. The screen has no allowance line. ERC4626._deposit uses safeTransferFrom(caller, this, assets).

findings.title: deposit: the one-word intent 'Deposit' with no interpolatedIntent names neither the amount nor the vault.

cases.notes: Shown right: 22.26 USDT0 out. Shares in: the receiver and ticker are right, the amount is not shown. The allowance spend is not shown.

effects: The vault burns bbqUSDT0 shares from `owner` equal to convertToShares(assets), rounded up. If the caller is not the owner, the caller's share allowance from the owner is spent.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)

formats.shown: Redeem: the exact bbqUSDT0 shares, the receiver and the owner; the asset received and its amount are not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDT0 as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem has fields only for shares, receiver and owner. ERC4626._withdraw sends `asset()` (0xc2132D…USDT0) to the receiver. Case 3: the signer received 22260997 USDT, and the reader wrote 'presumably USDT0'. The deposit and mint formats already use the ticker constant.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, and say it in interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT0 amount received is not shown; the vault's price decides it and the call takes no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor)`. Case 3: 22.260997 USDT arrived, with no amount on screen.

findings.title: redeem: the intent 'Redeem' with no interpolatedIntent does not say what comes back.
